newsitem.title: USA: AT&T wins United Tech contract.
newsitem.headline: AT&T wins United Tech contract.

text.p: AT&T Corp said Thursday it had won a multi-service global contract from United Technologies Corp worth $200 million over the next five years.
AT&T said it will provide United Technologies with wireless, Internet and advanced network management services worldwide.
AT&T said the contract covers bilateral and multilateral services delivered through AT&T and its partners, as well as discounts based on total customer spending worldwide.
United Technologies makes high-technology products for the aerospace, automotive and building industries.
